messages:
laura: fyi support ticket from tenant `insightly` - lots of 5xx and client timeouts reported around 03:12 UTC. they say requests hang and then get 502/504.
ops-bot: alert: hosted.gateway.queue_depth_count{tenant=insightly} == 496 for 00:14:10; gateway.p95 increased x3
matt: can you paste the sample request ids? need to trace them through the gateway + batcher.
laura: linked logs: https://logs.redwood.example/insightly/2026-03-17/0312 (redacted). support included a curl loop that reproduces the pattern.
priya: quick glance at metrics: continuous-batcher.queue_length spike to ~430 at the same time; batch_window auto-scaled up from 40ms to 180ms. dequeue throughput dropped.
amanda: customer repro: steady stream of short generate() calls at high concurrency, interspersed with occasional long-context calls (~3k tokens). they think long-context calls cause downstream stalls.
matt: that aligns - long-context requests hold large KV caches and enlarge batch windows, which causes short requests to queue behind them.
infra-eng: pulled snapshot:
```
hosted.gateway.queue_depth{pod=gateway-2} 496
continuous_batcher.queue_len{region=us-east} 438
batch_window_ms 40 -> 180
dequeue_rps 140 -> 28
continuous_batch_kv_hold_seconds > 6 for some sessions
```
priya: snowball effect: batcher increases window to try to meet p50, but that raises per-batch size and holds KV longer -> fewer batches, backlog grows.
laura: customer is frustrated and asked for immediate action; they've threatened to shift traffic.
matt: propose immediate mitigations (short-term):
- apply tenant routing override to a smaller-context model variant
- set a temporary concurrency cap for tenant to flatten burstiness
- force batch_window_ms to a lower hard cap for hosted gateway
- enable tenant-level aggressive prefix caching
amanda: I can flip a routing override to route `insightly` -> model-compact-v1 as a canary. also can set a soft concurrency cap. need go-ahead.
laura: go ahead with routing + cap. also notify customer when changes live.
ops-bot: action: tenant_override applied tenant=insightly route=model-compact-v1 by amanda at 6187654345
ops-bot: action: set tenant_concurrency_limit tenant=insightly limit=75 by amanda at 6187654346
matt: after changes, dequeue rps climbed back to ~120 and queue depth dropped to <60 within 90s.
laura: customer reports fewer 5xx immediately, but still rare p99 spikes when long requests slip through.
priya: created infra ticket INF-3421 to track longer-term fixes: per-tenant scheduling (short-first), KV hold eviction, and dynamic batch window hysteresis.
infra-eng: INF-3421 created - includes trace links and metric graphs. assigned to matt/priya.
amanda: requested repro artifacts from customer (the curl loop + sample long request). customer uploaded curl loop and example payloads to the support ticket.
matt: next steps for eng-runtime:
- implement dequeue priority by estimated token cost OR estimated KV size
- add eviction threshold to drop KV holders > Xs when queue_depth high
- expose tenant-level admission controls in console (concurrency, model fallback)
priya: also recommend doc for customers: best practices for mixing short and long requests (suggest using separate tenants or batching windows).
laura: scheduling incident walk-through tomorrow with eng-runtime, infra, and support. include customer contact for sign-off.
ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated at 6187654375; customer acknowledged improvement.
matt: I'll correlate the 5xx request ids and attach traces to INF-3421. ETA 24h.
laura: great work team. keep monitoring and post anything unusual here. :thumbsup:
